latest_release.name: v2.1.0
latest_release.body:
## Changes
* chore: bump version to 2.1.0.dev0 by @p-e-w in https://github.com/p-e-w/heretic/pull/558
* feat: allow specifying a custom config file path by @dreamfast in https://github.com/p-e-w/heretic/pull/557
* feat: add response length scorer by @p-e-w in https://github.com/p-e-w/heretic/pull/562
* fix: enforce memory residency for all model tensors by @p-e-w in https://github.com/p-e-w/heretic/pull/564
* fix: prevent errors during model reset from interrupting export by @p-e-w in https://github.com/p-e-w/heretic/pull/565
* perf: disable KV cache when obtaining module I/O by @p-e-w in https://github.com/p-e-w/heretic/pull/566
* fix: make batch size caching in benchmark scorer actually work by @p-e-w in https://github.com/p-e-w/heretic/pull/567
* fix: export plugin settings correctly by @p-e-w in https://github.com/p-e-w/heretic/pull/570 (additional tests contributed by @Vinay-Umrethe)
* docs: prepare for 2.1 release by @p-e-w in https://github.com/p-e-w/heretic/pull/572

## New Contributors
* @dreamfast made their first contribution in https://github.com/p-e-w/heretic/pull/557

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/p-e-w/heretic/compare/v2.0.0...v2.1.0
